1.consolidated_definition: Gallo mediocre. No es de raza. No acomete ni muestra coraje en la pelea. Este término pudo ser originalmente zamuri, p. 1409. En algunas partes de América es el aura tiñosa, ave de plumaje negro del tamaño de una gallina que se alimenta de animales muertos.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Gallo of inferior quality. Not of a pure breed. Does not engage in combat or show courage in fighting. This term may have originated from zamuri (p. 1409). In some parts of the Americas, it is also known as the "aura tiñosa", a bird with black plumage the size of a hen that feeds on dead animals.
